rows.name: Luminosity
rows.effect: Uncertainty on the integrated luminosity; scales every simulated yield
rows.construction: lnN 1.4% (2022), 1.3% (2023); all MC except free-floating tt; separate per year
rows.evidence: Configured. Official common-component correlation model not implemented

rows.name: Pileup
rows.effect: Uncertain distribution of extra pp collisions per crossing; changes MET, isolation, jet counts
rows.construction: Event-weight Up/Down from the pileup calibration; all MC

rows.name: μ ID
rows.effect: Data/MC difference in identifying a real muon
rows.construction: HWW tight-ID SF Up/Down per lepton; all MC

rows.name: μ isolation
rows.effect: Data/MC difference in a real muon looking isolated
rows.construction: Tight PF iso SF, conditional on ID

rows.name: μ prompt MVA
rows.effect: Efficiency of the prompt-MVA cut on real muons
rows.construction: ttH-MVA SF on top of ID×iso

rows.name: e ID
rows.effect: Data/MC difference for POG Medium electrons
rows.construction: Medium SF

rows.name: e prompt MVA
rows.effect: Efficiency of the prompt-MVA cut on real electrons
rows.construction: Medium+MVA conditional factor

rows.name: e reco
rows.effect: Electron reconstruction efficiency, measured in three p<sub>T</sub> ranges
rows.construction: Three independent nuisances by p<sub>T</sub> range

rows.name: μ scale
rows.effect: Uncertainty in the absolute muon momentum calibration; moves p<sub>T</sub>, m<sub>ℓℓ</sub>, m<sub>T</sub>
rows.construction: Object shift Up/Down; selection and features recomputed for each shift

rows.name: μ resolution
rows.effect: Uncertainty in the extra smearing that matches MC resolution to data (width, not mean)
rows.construction: Object shift Up/Down
rows.evidence: Deterministic per-event path implemented; output checks pending

rows.name: e scale
rows.effect: Uncertainty in the absolute electron energy calibration
rows.construction: Object shift Up/Down

rows.name: e resolution
rows.effect: Uncertainty in the electron energy smearing
rows.construction: Object shift Up/Down

rows.name: JES
rows.effect: Uncertainty in the jet energy response; moves jets, c-jet choice and MET
rows.construction: Total source Up/Down, propagated to MET

rows.name: JER
rows.effect: MC jet resolution vs data
rows.construction: Smearing Up/Down, propagated to MET

rows.name: Unclustered MET
rows.effect: Soft energy not in jets or leptons; enters MET and m<sub>T</sub>
rows.construction: Up/Down on the unclustered component

rows.name: c-tag
rows.effect: Data/MC difference in PNet CvsL/CvsB, which define the 11 categories (MVA inputs)
rows.construction: 2D SF Total Up/Down

rows.name: Trigger
rows.effect: Online selection efficiency
rows.construction: SFs disabled by earlier decision
rows.evidence: No nuisance; not a measured zero

backup-syst-theory.title: Theory: parton shower, scales, top p<sub>T</sub>

rows.name: ISR / FSR
rows.effect: Shower radiation from incoming / outgoing partons; changes jet activity
rows.construction: PS weight pairs; all processes except tt; one name across processes and eras

rows.name: μR, μF
rows.effect: Missing higher orders: renormalisation and factorisation scale choice
rows.construction: LHE weights ×2 and ×0.5; three directions (not an envelope); running-Yukawa fix for H+c/H+b

rows.name: Top pT
rows.effect: Data prefer a softer top p<sub>T</sub> than MC
rows.construction: Nominal reweighted; Down = none, Up = symmetric

rows.name: H + heavy flavour
rows.effect: Uncertain rate of ggH/VBF with a real c-jet
rows.construction: ±50% on ggH/VBF events with a GEN c-jet (p<sub>T</sub>>25, |η|<2.5)
rows.evidence: Replaces flat 40% on all Higgs bkg

rows.name: PDF shape
rows.effect: Parton momentum and flavour content of the proton; changes acceptance and shape
rows.construction: Hessian members (4FS); MC-replica std (Arm B 3FS); inclusive rate removed per member

rows.name: H+c PDF rate
rows.effect: PDF uncertainty on the inclusive signal cross section
rows.construction: lnN 1.074, both arms

rows.name: αS
rows.effect: Uncertainty in α<sub>S</sub>(m<sub>Z</sub>), distinct from scale choice
rows.construction: Event weights where members exist
rows.evidence: 4FS H+c has no αS pair

rows.name: H+c αS rate
rows.effect: α<sub>S</sub> effect on the signal rate
rows.construction: Needs a process-specific calculation (PDF4LHC recipe)

rows.name: H+b PDF⊕αS
rows.effect: Theory rate of H+b inside the Higgs background
rows.construction: Candidate +3.36/−3.44%

rows.name: A: 3FS vs 4FS
rows.effect: 4FS vs 3FS give different charm kinematics
rows.construction: Shape from leading GEN c-hadron p<sub>T</sub>: Up = 3FS-like, Down = 2 − Up; Arm A only

rows.name: B: stitching
rows.effect: How 3FS (≥1 c-jet) and 4FS (0 c-jet) regions are joined
rows.construction: Per-era stitch factors; A's scheme nuisance off
rows.evidence: Missing-rate, scale and PDF consistency checks pending

rows.name: negrw
rows.effect: Spread of the negative-weight model on V+jets
rows.construction: 20-member ensemble spread; per-era/sample yield preserved
rows.evidence: Band does not cover all shape bias; fit-bin closure open

rows.name: Single top
rows.effect: Inclusive cross-section uncertainty

rows.name: Diboson / V+jets
rows.effect: Inclusive cross sections of merged groups

rows.name: Higgs bkg / BRs
rows.effect: Production rate; BR(H→WW), BR(H→ττ)
rows.construction: 5%; 1% each on the whole merged group

rows.name: tt normalisation
rows.effect: Free in the fit, constrained by the tt CR
rows.construction: rateParam, range [0, 5]

rows.name: MC statistics
rows.effect: Finite simulated events per bin (incl. negative weights)
rows.construction: Barlow–Beeston-lite per bin from Σw²; threshold 10 events
